Wanted Notices and Bounties.text: Wanted notices in Japan are police posters, not bounties, and only the police may offer a reward. Notices for villains at large hang in police boxes, stations and post offices and run on the news and police websites, with a photo or sketch, a description of the Quirk and a number to call. For the most serious cases the police can offer a public reward for information leading to an arrest, usually a few million yen at most and paid only after a conviction. The Hero Killer's notice is posted in several prefectures. Heroes earn nothing extra for catching a wanted villain beyond their normal case pay and credit. Private bounty hunting is illegal: a civilian who tracks and captures a wanted person for money is a vigilante under the law, however the hunt ends. The underworld keeps its own bounties, prices put on rivals, informers and sometimes heroes, paid through brokers, and the police treat any such offer as conspiracy.
